findings.finding: The door head reads as a flat stepped lintel with a dark band, not a pointed Gothic arch; at 1x the frame looks rectangular like the other UP kits.
findings.fix: Raise the frame's centre 2px and step the inner edge 1px per row toward the apex so it forms a visible point, using the stone highlight on the left slope and a mid shade on the right.

findings.finding: No floor shadow at the foot of the bottom row, so the first steps look pasted on the flagstones instead of standing on them.
findings.fix: Add a 1px darkest-floor shade along the east side and a 1px band under the bottom riser (light comes from the upper left).

findings.finding: The north balustrade stands frontally above the hole and the side rails run full height, so at 1x the 2x2 can be read as a stone hearth or fireplace before it reads as a floor opening.
findings.fix: Shorten the north balusters to 2px, give the north cap a 1px lit top plane, and continue the floor flagstone joints 1px inside the outer rim on the west and east sides so the rim sits in the floor plane.

findings.finding: The inner west and east walls do not visibly widen with depth; the inside reads as a rectangular box.
findings.fix: Step the inner wall shade 1px inward on each side per tread going north (darkest at the north tread).

findings.finding: At 1x the brass rivets in the frame read as a dotted stitch or string of lights, not rivets.
findings.fix: Space the rivets every 3px instead of every 2px and give each one a 1px dark iron pixel below it as a shadow.

findings.finding: There is no shadow where the bottom row meets the floor.
findings.fix: Add a 1px dark floor band under the bottom tread and on the east side.

findings.finding: The timber frame uses the same oak ramp as the bookshelves on either side, so the stair partly blends into the shelf row in the place.
findings.fix: Darken the frame posts one palette step, or add a 1px dark gap between the frame and each bookshelf; keep the warm lit top treads as the main cue.

findings.finding: The white dropping pixel on the middle tread is the brightest pixel in the piece and pulls the eye away from the lit top treads.
findings.fix: Change it to the light-stone tone and keep at most one white pixel.

findings.finding: Like the castle down stair, the wooden frame at 1x/3x can be read as a hearth or cage. The straw on the nearest tread is too small to help.
findings.fix: Shorten the north balusters, give the north rail a lit top plane, and run 1px of floor stone inside the outer rail on the west and east sides.

places.finding: Clocktower: the stair sits correctly against the north wall at the west end, with no wall cut-through, but there is no floor shadow at its foot.
places.fix: Add a 1px shade under and east of the bottom row, as for the piece.

places.finding: Owlery: the down stairwell at (1,8) is tight against the west wall pilaster, so its west rail nearly merges with the wall edge at 1x.
places.fix: Leave a 1px floor gap, or darken the rail's west outline pixel so the rail separates from the pilaster.

places.finding: Honeydukes: the stair fits between the bookshelves cleanly. It looks slightly like a third shelf (see the piece finding).
